title: 찍고 지우고 또 찍고
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop, Bubblegum Pop. Bright, layered male vocals with tight harmonies and unison choruses. The arrangement features a syncopated slap bass line, clean funk-style electric guitar scratches, and a driving electronic drum kit with a crisp snare and punchy kick. Polished synth pads and staccato brass-style synth stabs punctuate the transitions. The tempo is 124 BPM in the key of B Major. The production uses frequent vocal ad-libs, rhythmic breathing sounds, and sudden instrumental drop-outs for dynamic contrast.
suno_analysis_lyrics:

[slap bass, funk guitar, electronic drums]
(Yeah, oh yeah, oh-oh-oh, oh-oh-oh)
